newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African late bonds twitchy, rand struggles.
newsitem.headline: S.African late bonds twitchy, rand struggles.

text.p: 1430 GMT - Late bonds off intraday weakest levels but twitchy. Worries over worse-than-expected latest credit data overshadow positive inflation and trade numbers.
Rand still struggling after day marked by persistent dollar demand and Reserve Bank absence, forex dealers say.
* Benchmark R150 last at 14.130 pct from intraday 14.18 pct high and 14.01 at previous local close.
* Bond market troubled by softer rand and Monday's credit data and players wary to go long on stock.
* Wednesday's range seen between around 14.05 to 14.14 percent.

* Currency last at 4.5880/5910 vs dollar from 4.5725/5755 overnight. Mostly importer dollar demand offset briefly by some profit-taking out of London. Fairly large speculative flows also seen, dealers say.
